# netskope_aig_appliance_image_list (Data Source)

Read-only data source listing available VM image downloads for AIG appliances per hypervisor platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_appliance_image_list" "my_aigapplianceimagelist" {
}
```
